Yesterday was our last day in Korea and we stopped at Jeju Island. A lovely place of tangerines and volcanic rocks. We hiked about 1400 meters up Hallasan, a volcano located in Hallasan National Park. We didn’t make it to the end of the trail, but it was very pretty.  

Today, we head out to our first Japanese port: Fukuoka! 

Goodbye, Korea. You were amazing and we’ll be back.

We got into Hiroshima this morning and had a nice late disembarkment. We decided to head to Saijo for the sake brewery street and we happened to stumble into their annual autumn sake festival! We had a great time trying various sake and eating street food before heading back and getting some okonomiyaki from a food stall on the 6th floor of a building. 

All in all, a great day. Tomorrow is a day off at sea and then two days in port for Osaka and Kyoto.

Another amazing yet tiring day. We are docked in Osaka but we took transit to Kyoto to see the Senbon Torii (Thousand Torii Gates) at Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine. We ended up making the trek to the top of Mt Inari (about 660ft altitude change) and back down. We then walked around Kyoto a bit more and going down some shopping streets and historical areas. 

We made our way back to Osaka for the Dotonbori market (a huge market of food, bars, and other shopping). We got more okonomiyaki (this is slightly different from the last one) and some ice cream before heading back to the ship. 

Tomorrow, we are still here..we’ll see what adventure awaits.

Today we had a stop in Shimizu port and had an excursion to Hakone to get views of Mt Fuji. 

We took a long bus ride to the Hakone ropeway and took the cable car to the top and got some amazing views of Fujisan. She was shy, but came from behind the clouds a few times. 

We then went to Hakone Shrine and then back to the port and tried some local food. I got fried sakura shrimp rice bowl and Alessa got some tuna sushi. 

Now we rest for the final port tomorrow; Tokyo. We stay in port overnight and then we head to our hotel for a few nights.

Last port, Yokohama/Tokyo. We spent the day in Tokyo wandering around and shopping.  We’ll be back in Tokyo proper tomorrow for a few days before our trip home.
